name: Handsome B☆Y's ~Koisuru Kimi ni Shinuhodo Muchuu~
original_name: ハンサムB☆Y's～恋する君に死ぬほど夢中～
source:
The player takes on the role of a transfer student returning to their childhood town. On the first day of school, they reunite with their childhood friend Sakata and are invited to become the manager of the light music club. The story unfolds as a chaotic school life romantic comedy featuring the four club members, who are voiced by the actual members of Urashimasakatasen (Uratanuki, Shima, Tonari no Sakata, and Senra).

Officially described as a "text adventure", the game features gameplay elements. It includes high-penalty choices that result in sudden Game Overs, and a unique word-spelling mini-game used during climactic story moments to progress (such as spelling "I like you" to successfully confess).
translation:
玩家将扮演一名重返儿时故乡小镇的转学生。开学第一天，主角便与青梅竹马坂田重逢，并受邀担任轻音部的经理。故事围绕四名社团成员展开了一段鸡飞狗跳的校园恋爱喜剧，四位角色均由歌唱组合“浦岛坂田船”的真人成员（Uratanuki、志麻、邻家坂田与Senra）亲自献声配音。

本作官方定位为“文字冒险游戏”，同时融入了丰富的互动玩法要素：不仅设有选错即刻突然Game Over的高惩罚选项，还在剧情高潮时刻加入了独特的拼词小游戏以推进故事（例如成功拼出“我喜欢你”才能顺利完成告白）。
